activities_accept_ck.name: activities_accept_ck
activities_accept_ck.value: accept_status is null or accept_status in ('pendente','aceita','devolvida')

arp_ledger_dir_ck.name: arp_ledger_dir_ck
arp_ledger_dir_ck.value: dir is null or dir in ('saida','entrada')

contacts_nature_ck.name: contacts_nature_ck
contacts_nature_ck.value: nature is null or nature in ('publica', 'privada')

contract_commitment_moves_qty_ck.name: contract_commitment_moves_qty_ck
contract_commitment_moves_qty_ck.value: qty4 > 0 or (kind = 'reforco_valor' and qty4 = 0 and value4 > 0)

cost_items_impact_ck.name: cost_items_impact_ck
cost_items_impact_ck.value: impact is null or impact in ('material','servico','operacional','entrega','taxa_venda')

interventions_manual_ck.name: interventions_manual_ck
interventions_manual_ck.value: trigger <> 'manual' or (title is not null and reason is not null)

interventions_auto_ck.name: interventions_auto_ck
interventions_auto_ck.value: trigger = 'manual' or (series_id is not null and goal_id is not null)

interventions_decision_ck.name: interventions_decision_ck
interventions_decision_ck.value: review_decision is null or review_decision in ('manter', 'plano')

sales_branches_regime_ck.name: sales_branches_regime_ck
sales_branches_regime_ck.value: tax_regime is null or tax_regime in ('simples_nacional','lucro_presumido','lucro_real','mei')
